subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale guard assertions are repaired, does openclaw/openclaw-secops approve the selected immutable revisions for the token- and security-sensitive workflows?
rationale: The patch changes third-party code that receives sensitive credentials and security permissions, so the repository's named security owner must accept the exact supply-chain boundary.

options.title: Approve after guard repair
options.body: Require the assertion updates and focused exact-head gates, then approve the reviewed immutable revisions.

options.title: Hold sensitive revisions
options.body: Retain current-main pins for sensitive actions until secops selects or validates different revisions.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard repair
recommendation.body: Require the assertion updates and focused exact-head gates, then approve the reviewed immutable revisions.
